admission.authority: direct user instruction to preserve partially effective prior shortcuts as a dedicated low-cost rotating toolkit instead of discarding non-universal wins
admission.reason: Preserve locally useful multiplier-order, filter, transport, and metadata shortcuts behind exact fallback and regime telemetry.

methods.name: BRC opportunistic shortcut portfolio
capabilities: preserve historically positive but non-universal shortcut prefixes and route signals
round-robin cheap multiplier experts while deduplicating candidates
append the exact mod-8 structural fallback after every heuristic prefix
record per-regime attempts, hits, probe costs and saved costs
retain the learned 20-multiplier prefix, ratio-cover prefix and 13-kernel prefix as bounded specialists
use exact gap sorting only when completion-gap states are already materialized
expose an exact LOW12 compact square-gap necessary-condition filter
route table-free, quotient-jet, energy-jet and ultra-large residue-jet backends by cheap context rather than universal promotion
preserve metadata-triggered Pisano/rank probing only when metadata setup cost is already sunk
retain cheap N/J/R/phase shadow signatures for per-regime telemetry without promoting the failed classifier
preserve Fibonacci/delete-code as a storage-only specialist when representation size rather than factor leakage is the objective
adapt trial ordering only after a configurable minimum sample count using regime-local empirical net saving
provide a finite rank-only recheck showing learned-prefix and round-robin tradeoffs on two current mod-8 populations
methods.core_law: A heuristic shortcut may change only trial order or bounded prefix. Specialist candidates are deduplicated, then every remaining exact mod-8 scan representative is appended through prioritized_odd_multiplier_order. Therefore shortcut failure cannot change mathematical coverage. RegimeShortcutLedger separately estimates local expected net saving so non-universal positive regions remain discoverable.
methods.hard_boundary: No heuristic prefix is a factorization theorem or scan replacement. Learned/ration-cover/kernel prefixes may miss and require fallback. Empirical crossover thresholds are environment-specific. Pisano/rank probing is opportunistic only when metadata is already available. No Foundation or Working Truth promotion. Cheap shadow tags are telemetry only unless later evidence justifies routing; Fibonacci/delete-code is storage-only and is not a factor oracle.
